card.title: Senior Director, Quality AI, Data & Technology Engineering
card.description:
Job Description 
 General Summary: 

 Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation to create transformative medicines for people with serious diseases. As Vertex continues to grow, we are accelerating capabilities in technology and data to remain at the forefront of science, medicine, and technology.

 The Data & Technology Engineering, Biopharmaceutical Science, Manufacturing, Supply & Quality organization is focused on improving patients’ lives through AI, data, and technology innovation.

 The Senior Director, Quality AI, Data & Technology Engineering will define and execute the strategic vision for transforming Vertex’s global Quality operations through AI, data, and technology. This leader will champion AI-driven approaches that enhance the complete suite of quality activities including batch release, assurance, oversight, compliance, inspection readiness, deviation management, corrective and preventive actions.

 Working across multiple Vertex business units, internal teams, external partners, and operating models, this role is accountable for advancing the end-to-end global Quality experience. The Senior Director will serve as a key member of the Data & Technology Engineering leadership community and the Data & Technology Engineering, Biopharmaceutical Science, Manufacturing, Supply & Quality Leadership Team, partnering with leaders in Quality, Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, data science, infrastructure, data platforms, and security to deliver smart, scalable, and compliant solutions.

 Key Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Vision and Strategy Develop, communicate, and execute a clear vision for AI-powered Quality technology solutions across Vertex’s global internal and external operations.
 Shape a strategic roadmap that applies generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, data products, and data-driven automation to transform Quality processes.
 Partner closely with Quality leadership to ensure technology strategies accelerate portfolio and commercial priorities while enabling operational excellence.
 Lead strategic thinking across Quality oversight, inspection readiness, batch release, compliance, and related global Quality activities.
 Influence stakeholders across a broad internal and external ecosystem to identify and prioritize opportunities for innovation.
 
 Operational Execution
 Identify, evaluate, and advance opportunities involving AI, data science, data products, internal and external integrations, software, protocols, and technology platforms.
 Assess the applicability, value, risks, and compliance considerations of AI-enabled solutions within regulated Quality environments.
 Deliver strategic, flexible, scalable, and reusable technology solutions aligned with Vertex architectural principles, standards, and governance.
 Establish disciplined operating practices that maximize financial, resource, and operational effectiveness.
 Lead a robust Quality technology operation that enables dependable support for drug research, manufacturing, and product supply while maximizing return on investment.
 Partner with external suppliers to ensure high-quality delivery that meets Vertex expectations for compliance, security, and performance.
 Drive coordinated digital transformation initiatives across CMC, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality.
 
 Leadership and Collaboration
 Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing and diverse team of technology professionals.
 Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, inclusion, diversity, and equity.
 Align the Quality technology organization and data strategy with enterprise priorities, business outcomes, and regulatory requirements.
 Represent the Quality technology organization in internal and external forums, advocating for innovation and the organization’s ability to achieve strategic objectives.
 Build trusted partnerships with leaders and teams across Quality, Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, data science, technology, infrastructure, data platforms, and security.
 
 
 Knowledge and Skills: 
 Experience creating and applying technologies to solve computationally intensive and data-intensive challenges within Quality or similarly regulated life sciences environments.
 Demonstrated success developing and implementing technology strategies within complex organizations, preferably pharmaceutical Quality organizations.
 Proven experience delivering multiple complex technology development or transformation initiatives.
 Extensive knowledge of global Quality environments and the ability to translate user needs into effective technology solutions.
 Strong understanding of biotech regulatory requirements, compliance, and integrity in systems, processes, and actions.
 Demonstrated ability to communicate strategic ideas, technology solutions, and complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences at all organizational levels.
 Exceptional strategic thinking, problem-solving, organizational leadership, and team-building capabilities.
 
 Technical Skills Required
 Artificial intelligence and machine learning
 Generative AI and agentic AI
 Data-driven automation
 Data products and data science
 Quality technology platforms and transactional systems
 Quality assurance and Quality oversight technology
 Inspection readiness and inspection management
 Deviation management
 Corrective and preventive action processes
 Product batch release processes
 Internal and external technology integrations
 Software and technology solution evaluation
 Data platforms and infrastructure
 Cybersecurity and technology security considerations
 Distributed computing environments
 Cloud computing environments
 High-performance computing
 Technology architecture, standards, governance, and risk management
 
 Preferred Skills
 Experience leading AI, data, or technology transformation in a global pharmaceutical Quality organization.
 Experience supporting clinical and commercial supply operations.
 Experience working across CMC, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and R&D functions.
 Experience partnering with external technology suppliers and service providers in highly regulated environments.
 Advanced certification in product management, Agile, software engineering, leadership, or a related discipline.
 Experience developing scalable solutions that balance innovation, operational needs, regulatory compliance, and security.
 
 Education and Experience: 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Computer Science, Engineering)
 12+ years’ experience and 5+ years of management experience
 2+ year’s experience setting agentic AI vision and governance framework development
 
 #LI-KO1 #LI-Hybrid 


 At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.
 
 Pay Range: 
$256,000 - $384,000 
 Disclosure Statement: 
 The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.
 
 At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations.  From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

 In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as: 
1.     Hybrid : work remotely up to two days per week; or select 
2.     On-Site : work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.
 Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

Job Description 
 General/Position Summary 
 The Senior Director, CGT Quality Systems, Personalized Medicine provides strategic Quality leadership for personalized medicine and advanced cell therapies across the patient journey. The role is accountable for advancing Quality oversight, governance, compliance, and continuous improvement while ensuring efficient, patient-centric process across the end to end patient journey.
 This highly cross-functional position requires strong matrix leadership and partnership with Global Quality and Manufacturing, MS&T, Regulatory, Commercial, and Supply Chain stakeholders.  Success requires the ability to influence enterprise decisions, build strong partnerships, and drive alignment through executive presence and effective communication.   The  ability to balance long-term vision with flawless execution of complex business and quality priorities is key for the position.
 
 Key Duties & Responsibilities 
 Leadership, Strategy & Organizational Capabilities 
 Provide strategic Quality Systems leadership in support of personalized medicine /advanced CGT programs, ensuring alignment with CGT Business Objectives, Vertex Global Quality Strategy, commercial priorities, regulatory expectations, and patient-centered outcomes.
 Define, prioritize, and execute the CGT Quality Systems across clinical, launch, and commercial lifecycle stages.
 Partner with stakeholders to ensure effective risk management, resolution and mitigation plans are identified, established, and executed.
 Lead, mentor, and develop team members; build organizational capability and foster accountability, collaboration, innovation, and operational excellence.
 Leverage technical and Quality expertise across CGT QA to resolve critical challenges, drive timely decision-making, and ensure effective communication and escalation of risks, constraints, and commitments.
 Create and foster a culture of collaboration, quality excellence, continuous improvement, transparency, and accountability across Quality and partner functions.
 Responsible for leading and participating in key CMC Quality initiatives to advance and mature Vertex’s  Global Quality Systems.
 
 Quality Systems & Compliance Oversight for Advanced CGT Personalized Medicine
 Provide End to End compliance oversight for personalized medicine/advanced CGT internal and external quality operations, ensuring quality remains compliant with applicable enterprise Vertex Global Quality procedural requirements and global regulations.
 Establish compliance governance routines to proactively monitor compliance trends, operational performance, and emerging risks that may impact product quality, patient safety, supply continuity, or program execution; lead or support risk-based mitigation plans, continuous improvement actions, and sustainable process enhancements.
 Partner with digital stakeholders to ensure CGT user requirements are embedded in lifecycle management projects from design through implementation including sustainment.
 Support inspection readiness and audit-related activities in relation to Quality CGT oversight.
 
 Patient Treatment Journey Quality Oversight
 Lead and provide Quality oversight across the end to end patient CGT treatment journey assuring GMP requests are assessed, governed, documented, escalated, and resolved in a timely, compliant, risk-based, and patient-centric manner.
 Chair or support cross-functional review of GMP related patient treatment journey requests including requests involving patient-specific constraints.
 Ensure Quality Management Review Boards are executed in line with Global Quality System requirements when quality or compliance impact is identified across the patient treatment journey.
 Analytics, Data Integrity & Continuous Improvement
 Partner with Global Quality and cross-functional stakeholders to support development and deployment of advanced digital reporting solutions and use of artificial intelligence in CGT to enable transparent governance, decision-making, and escalation of quality and operational risks.
 Improve compliance and strengthen proactive quality management, efficiency, data integrity, and processes maturity  and scalability across CGT investigations, change controls, risk assessments, CAPA, and management review.
 
 Required Education Level 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, or related technical discipline required.
 
 Required Experience 
 15+ years of experience and 7+ years in a management/supervisory role, or the equivalent combination of education and experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment
 
 Required Knowledge/Skills 
 Broad experience in quality and compliance oversight for allogeneic/autologous cell manufacturing processes, or other personalized medicine modalities from development through commercial lifecycle.
 In-depth knowledge of global health authority expectations and GxP requirements across the lifecycle for cell and gene therapy, biologics, and advanced therapy products.

 Balance long-term vision with operational excellence, driving quality transformation while ensuring compliance and patient-focused outcomes.

card.description:
**Universal Ingredients**

*Innovative Plant-Based Solutions for Global Industries*

Universal Ingredients is a global supplier of high-quality, plant-based specialty ingredients for human and pet consumption. With thousands of products and global sourcing capabilities, we provide customized, value-added solutions – including fruit and vegetable juices and concentrates, dehydrated ingredients, botanical extracts, flavors, and beverage systems – for food and beverage manufacturers worldwide.

Our advanced production capabilities, including aseptic beverage processing and flexible packaging solutions, enable safe, shelf-stable products with no preservatives. At the heart of our innovation is our Application Capabilities Lab, where food science experts collaborate with customers to develop market-ready solutions through product development, flavor analysis, sensory testing, and commercialization support.

Driven by innovation, sustainability, and partnership, Universal Ingredients helps customers stay ahead of evolving consumer preferences while delivering consistent quality, functionality, and performance across global markets.

Disclaimer: Shank’s Extracts manufactures various products that identify as major food allergens (milk, eggs, tree nuts, wheat, and soybeans) as well as several other food ingredients. We cannot guarantee you will not be exposed to skin and/or odor contact with these various ingredients. Your health and safety are our number one priority, and we will do our best to accommodate within reason.

**Summary**

Universal Ingredients is seeking a **Food Safety & Quality Director** to lead our Quality, Food Safety, and Regulatory functions. This leader will establish and strengthen quality systems across the organization, ensure regulatory and food safety compliance, and partner closely with Operations, Commercialization, R&D, Procurement, and Commercial teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with practical manufacturing leadership and has a track record of building a **preventive, accountable quality culture** focused on getting things right the first time.

**What You'll Be Doing (Essential Duties)**

* Lead the overall **Quality, Food Safety, and Regulatory strategy** for Universal Ingredients.
* Establish consistent quality standards, systems, policies, and performance expectations across the organization.
* Ensure compliance with applicable **FDA, FSMA, GMP, HACCP, SQF/GFSI, labeling, and customer requirements**.
* Strengthen **root-cause analysis, CAPA, change control, SOP/SSOP, and audit processes**.
* Partner with Operations to improve **first-pass quality** and reduce complaints, deviations, holds, rework, and recurring quality issues.
* Lead customer complaint management, regulatory inspections, certification audits, and customer audits.
* Oversee **supplier quality, regulatory documentation, specifications, labeling, and product compliance**.
* Support new product commercialization by embedding Quality and Regulatory requirements early in the process.
* Maintain strong **traceability, recall preparedness, and crisis-management** processes.
* Develop and lead a high-performing Quality and Regulatory organization while fostering shared accountability for quality and food safety across the business.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Engineering, or related field.
* Progressive Quality, Food Safety, and/or Regulatory leadership experience in **food, beverage, flavors, ingredients, or related manufacturing**.
* Experience in Aseptic process manufacturing
* Strong knowledge of FDA food regulations, FSMA, GMPs, HACCP, supplier quality, sanitation, traceability, and recall management.
* Experience leading audits, inspections, investigations, root-cause analysis, and CAPA.

card.description:
DuPage Machine Products a high volume, high precision metal turning machine shop, is seeking a Quality Director to maintain and enhance the organization’s Quality Assurance activities by planning, implementing and evaluating quality related resources, equipment, software, policies, programs and practices.

The successful candidate will oversee the entire company’s quality system at the strategic level and monitor the day to day quality operations by directing multiple reporting engineers, technicians and supervisors. The appropriate candidate will interact with outside customers and potential clients. This individual will monitor, support and delegate inspection activities, personnel, PPAP, rework, and ISO activities.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

* **Bachelor of Science degree in a technical field**
* **In-depth knowledge of Quality Systems, including statistics and computer skills**
* **Problem solving and team building skills**
* **Customer and supplier response and interaction skills**
* **Oral and written communications skills**
* **10 years of Quality Management experience**
* **CQM and/or CQE certifications preferred.**

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: \* Deal professionally with customers, suppliers and internal departments as required to resolve quality issues.

* Work closely with production personnel to improve productivity and quality.
* Develop, maintain, and implement the DuPage Machine Products Quality System
* Set direction of the quality program
* Develop and implement long range strategy for Quality Department
* Upgrade Quality Assurance personnel, equipment, methods and procedures
* Establish organization-wide Quality Performance Measurement and Reporting Systems
* Define Quality Policies, Procedures, Work Instructions and Forms
* Supervision of personnel in the Quality Department
* Hire, review and terminate personnel in the Quality Department
* Work with Engineering on developing Quality Standards
* Purchase Quality related equipment and outside services
* Monitor Customer Quality Requirements
* Establish relationships with our customers
* Establish relationships with our suppliers
* Establish relationships with Operations personnel
* Member of Management Team
* Member of the Material Review Board
* ISO Management Representative
* Define ISO Internal Audit Schedule
* Train Internal ISO Auditors

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* ISO 9001: 7 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

card.title: General Manager, Data Operations
card.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As General Manager of Data Operations, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.

card.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the role & team**
-------------------------

We are building a central BU Authenticity Guarantee (AG) Centre of Excellence within eBay’s GFC organisation to strengthen the AG proposition and scale shared capabilities.

 
 

As **Director, AG Strategy & Operations**, you will report to the **GM, Portfolio Strategy & Operations — Global Focus Categories & Live**. You will examine and refine the cross-category strategy, lead and develop a high-performing team, and translate priorities into measurable business outcomes. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strategic judgment, operational understanding, and accountability for delivery—not just recommendations.

 
 

You will work closely alongside category divisions, which own category initiatives and commercial outcomes, and AuthOps, which manages authentication operations.

 
 

**What you will accomplish**
----------------------------

* **AG Strategy & Proposition:** Review and evolve the cross-category AG strategy, customer promise, and shared roadmap. Establish common experience standards and commercial guardrails, balancing consistency with category-specific needs.
* **Business Cases & Investment Prioritisation:** Build clear processes to develop, evaluate, and prioritise cases.Bring together category, finance, product, and AuthOps input to assess customer value, economics, operational feasibility, and expected returns.
* **Hands-On Execution:** Own cross-category initiatives from planning through delivery, with clear achievements and accountability. Spend time in AG centres to understand workflows, customer problems, and operational constraints, translating these insights into practical improvements with category teams and AuthOps.
* **Performance & Scalable Processes:** Establish critical metrics, operating reviews, and reusable launch and expansion playbooks.Track results against arguments, address gaps, and scale successful approaches across categories and markets.
* **People & Cross-Functional Leadership:** Lead and develop the team, aligning partners across category leadership, product, engineering, marketing, AuthOps, and other functions. Resolve dependencies, drive decisions, and communicate clear recommendations and progress to senior leadership.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* **Strategic & commercial judgment:** Significant experience in strategy, business operations, or general management, with strong business-case development, financial analysis, and investment prioritisation skills.
* **Execution & ownership:** A proven record of turning strategy into measurable results. A hands-on approach to understanding operations, solving problems, and delivering improvements, including willingness to travel to AG centres.
* **People & collaborator leadership:** Demonstrated success developing teams and influencing senior collaborators across business, product, and operations, with clear accountability for outcomes.
* **Analytical & communication skills:** Ability to translate data and customer insights into actionable recommendations and executive-ready communications. Experience in marketplaces, eCommerce, or customer trust is preferred; direct authentication experience is a plus.

**Why join us**
---------------

Help shape AG across eBay, building a team that connects customer trust with commercial growth and delivers improvements across categories and markets.

At eBay, our customers are our compass. We foster a culture where authenticity thrives, bold ideas are encouraged, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work.

**Additional Details**

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$195,200 - $260,600

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guideline.

### **Job Description:**

Director, Executive Protection, Protective Operations and Logistics

The Role:

The position requires close collaboration with Global Security Operations, the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), Travel Security, and key internal and external partners to implement and support Fidelity's executive protection strategy. Success in this role requires exceptional organizational, leadership, and relationship-management skills, as well as the ability to balance competing priorities while delivering consistent, discreet, and service-oriented experience for Fidelity's senior leadership.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

* 7-10 years of experience protecting C-suite executives, board members, and/or government officials in complex, dynamic, and globally distributed operating environments within corporate, government, military, or law enforcement settings.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple workstreams
* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executives, business leaders, security professionals, and external stakeholders
* Extensive knowledge of executive protection operations, including protective advances, travel security, transportation security, venue assessment, route planning and protective operations logistics.
* Expertise in assessing, prioritizing, and coordinating executive support requests while balancing risk, resource requirements, and business priorities.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required and operate effectively in dynamic, rapidly changing, and high-pressure environments.
* Strong understanding of TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program requirements, administration, compliance, certifications, and operational integration; the ability to obtain and maintain ASO certification is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage executive protection staffing models, personnel scheduling, resource allocation, and operational readiness across multiple locations and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, develop, and build high-performing teams while fostering a culture of professionalism, accountability, discretion, and service excellence.
* Experience coordinating and supporting executive travel, special events, corporate meetings, and other high-visibility engagements requiring detailed planning and collaboration.
* Experience managing executive transportation programs, including vehicle operations, driver standards, fleet utilization, and transportation security protocols.
* Experience developing and managing executive protection training programs, operational exercises, performance standards, readiness assessments, and professional development initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree is preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Relevant professional certifications such as CTM, CPP, PSP, ASIS Executive Protection Professional (EPP), TSA ASO, or other intelligence, investigation, or executive protection credentials are a plus.
* undefined

* Manage and enhance the TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program, executive transportation services, training initiatives, and other core executive protection capabilities.

* Develop enterprise standards that improve service consistency, efficiency, and customer experience across all regions.
* Build scalable operational frameworks supporting future growth and digital transformation.
* Establish governance for global service capabilities and operational excellence initiatives.

**Service Lifecycle Management**

* Standardize lifecycle planning, service documentation, training, spare parts readiness, and support models.

**Knowledge Management & Service Enablement**

* Own the global knowledge management strategy supporting service engineers and technical support organizations.
* Develop standardized technical content, troubleshooting guides, repair procedures, and digital knowledge assets.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) principles to improve service effectiveness.
* Ensure service knowledge remains accurate, accessible, and continuously improved.

**Technical Support & Escalation Management**

* Lead the global technical support organization responsible for advanced troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Establish enterprise escalation governance for complex customer and product issues.
* Drive root cause analysis in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Product teams.
* Ensure lessons learned from escalations translate into improved products, documentation, and service processes.

**Service Platforms & Digital Enablement**

* Lead strategy and adoption for global service platforms and digital service technologies.
* Partner with Digital and IT organizations to define the future roadmap for service enablement platforms.
* Drive adoption of field service technologies, analytics, workflow automation, and AI-enabled service capabilities.
* Ensure platforms support efficient, standardized service execution globally.

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Build leadership capability across Service Product Management, Technical Support, Service Platforms, and Service Operations.
* Foster a collaborative, customer-focused culture emphasizing accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Champion organizational development, succession planning, and talent growth across the global service capability organization.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related field required.
* MBA or Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in global service organizations, technical support, customer success, or operational excellence.
* Experience leading enterprise service capabilities within complex global matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated success building global operating models and scalable service capabilities.
* Strong understanding of service lifecycle management, technical support, knowledge management, and digital service technologies.
* Experience leading organizational transformation and enterprise change initiatives.
* Financial and operational management experience, including forecasting, investment prioritization, and productivity improvement.

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, company 401k, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform critical job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in Massachusetts is $165,000.00–$200,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards
